subject: Cloud listing: SKU sample pack request + co-sell GTM asks
messages:
From: Suresh Rao <suresh.rao@cloudbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing — request for SKU sample pack + co-sell one-pager

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call this morning — excited to move forward with getting Redwood listed as a bundled offering through CloudBridge on AWS Marketplace. To get the technical intake started our ops team asked if you could share: 1) a small technical sample pack (containerized inference sample, model manifest, and a minimal README), 2) a SKU mapping file listing entitlements and metering SKUs, and 3) a short co-sell one-pager (what the offering is, target ICP, 3x GTM hooks).

Can you provide those artifacts or point me to the right person? We have an intake deadline on Oct 20 to make the upcoming marketplace refresh. Happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up if helpful.

Appreciate it —
Suresh
Partner Ops | CloudBridge Solutions
[attachment: sku_mapping.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood listing — request for SKU sample pack + co-sell one-pager

Looping you all in — Suresh from CloudBridge needs three items for AWS intake: the technical sample pack, SKU mapping, and a co-sell one-pager. Deadline Oct 20.

Ben: can you own the co-sell one-pager and GTM hooks? Keep it punchy (1 page).
Monica: can you work with Eng to produce the sample pack (container, model manifest, README) and confirm it runs on our single-node RH5 image? Target to hand to Suresh by Oct 17.
Olga: we’ll need the SKU metering mapping and evidence to satisfy AWS — legal may need sight before publishing; pls add Michael for billing verification.

If anyone needs the intake template, I attached last quarter's example.

Thanks —
Markus
VP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_marketplace_intake_template_vQ3.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Mark — I can draft the one-pager and the GTM bullets. Proposed outline:
- 1-line product positioning for marketplace catalog
- 3 ICP verticals and value props (SaaS analytics, enterprise search, regulated finance)
- Top 3 co-sell plays (joint demo, trial credits + integration workshop, performance-cost pitch)
- Required assets for listing page (logo, short description, bullet features, supported regions)

I'll send a first draft by EOD Oct 13. Monica/Olga — please ping me when you have sample pack/SKU mapping so I can call out exact entitlements in the one-pager. Question for Michael: do we have a standard trial credit amount we usually offer partners for co-sell demos (USD)?
